items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Dirk, what's that? Sights, piano player, drum. He was a corner player.

ctx.x: Ask him who played with Dr. Ernest, who was in the band.

So who played with Dr. Ernest? Dr. Ernest. And Johnny. He had two fellas from a woman and a man from Shusewood. I forget that name. He was saxophone player. He looked like a white fella. And his wife looked like a Mexican. They was playing with us then. And then Duck was on bass. Johnny on drum. And his wife was on piano. And he was on saxophone. He was on saxophone. He was on saxophone. Let me see. One, two, let me see. Dirk, what's that? Sights, piano player, drum. He was a corner player. Oh, a little partner…
